description:
Our automated valuation for one property: the point estimate, the 80%
range around it, and a 0-100 confidence score derived from how wide that
range is.

Today this bundles the single `/valuation/avm` call, so it costs the same;
it exists so an agent can ask for "everything valuation" without tracking
which valuation endpoints exist. Agent quoting behaviour, land values,
negative gearing and the value series are separate calls.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**
